twin-doves.name: Twin Doves Golf Club
twin-doves.notes: 27 holes, members-only club, 368 Tran Ngoc Len, Thu Dau Mot. All three nines par 36. Read from official site https://twindovesgolf.vn/ (course section). Cross-checked with golfingrecord.com (Luna https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/53e7abf5-2e41-4f75-9162-3c270846fed1, Stella https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/39e167ae-fee0-4f10-adc0-158ed87bc663, Sole https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/2c3bcbd0-dc00-4868-b471-755485e53b87) - all identical. Note: the old domain twindovesgolf.com.vn now redirects/serves twindovesgolf.vn. Since July 2025 Binh Duong province is administratively merged into Ho Chi Minh City.

song-be.name: Song Be Golf Resort
song-be.notes: 27 holes, 77 Dai Lo Binh Duong, Lai Thieu, Thuan An. All three nines par 36. Official course page prints the nines in Vietnamese as SAN HOA SEN (Lotus), SAN CAY CO (Palm), SAN SA MAC (Desert); English names Lotus/Palm/Desert are used on the resort's English scorecard (official scorecard PDF Sep-2025: https://songbegolf.com.vn/pictures/files/golf/the-diem-moi-2025/scorecard-9-25.pdf). Cross-checked with golfingrecord.com Lotus-Palm (https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/4b6df96f-530f-4632-a3c6-e5c5f90d222a) and Palm-Desert (https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/4b40c112-04ef-4a86-83d5-0731417dcaba) - identical.

harmonie-golf-park.name: Harmonie Golf Park
harmonie-golf-park.region: Binh Duong (Thu Dau Mot / Ben Cat)
harmonie-golf-park.notes: 18 holes (Jim Engh design), 469 Tran Ngoc Len, Dinh Hoa ward, Thu Dau Mot (directories list Thu Dau Mot rather than Ben Cat). Both nines par 36, course par 72. Official course page https://harmoniegolfpark.com/golf/ labels holes 1-9 'Lani' and 10-18 'Dani' (hole links 'Lani 1 Par 5' ... 'Dani 9 Par 5'). Pars cross-checked with golfpass.com scorecard (5-3-4-4-4-4-3-5-4 / 4-4-3-5-4-4-3-4-5) - identical. Disagreement: shotnavi.jp lists the nine names the other way round (Dani = holes 1-9, Lani = 10-18); the official site's order is used here.

mekong-golf-villas.name: Mekong Golf & Villas (Royal Island)
mekong-golf-villas.region: Binh Duong (Tan Uyen, Bach Dang island)
mekong-golf-villas.notes: 18 holes open (54 planned), Bach Dang island, Tan Uyen, Binh Duong. Both nines par 36, course par 72. Read from the official new 2026 scorecard image on https://mekonggolf.com/golf-course-2/ (Score-Card-moi-2026.jpg, tees Black/Blue/White/Red, no nine names - OUT/IN used). Disagreement: older third-party cards (golfify.io, golfadvisor/golfpass) show hole 1 as par 5 with OUT 37 / IN 35, and shotnavi.jp shows yet another set (36/37) - these appear to predate the 2026 re-card; the official 2026 card is used. Not to be confused with Mekong Golf Village in Long An.

legend-danang-golf-resort.name: Legend Danang Golf Resort
legend-danang-golf-resort.notes: 36 holes, renamed from BRG Danang Golf Resort (official site still dananggolfclub.com). Norman Course (Greg Norman 'Dunes', 2010) par 72 (36/36): official course-layout hole labels, identical to golfingrecord card. Nicklaus Course (2018/2020) par 73 (36/37): hole19 and golfingrecord cards agree (15th = par 4). Official Nicklaus-Course page hole labels list 15th as par 5 (which would sum to 74) while the same page states par 73, so the official labels look inconsistent; kept the par-73 third-party card. Tournament setups sometimes play 10th as par 4 (par 72).

ba-na-hills-golf-club.name: Ba Na Hills Golf Club
ba-na-hills-golf-club.notes: Par 72 (36/36), Luke Donald design, 2016. Official scorecard PDF (banahillsgolf.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Ba-Na-Hills-Golf-Club_Score-Card.pdf) returns 404, so card is third-party: hole19, golfingrecord and 18birdies all identical. Official hole pages confirm 8 = par 3, 14 = par 5, 16 = par 3 (island green).

montgomerie-links-vietnam.name: Montgomerie Links Vietnam
montgomerie-links-vietnam.region: Quang Nam (Dien Ban, between Da Nang and Hoi An)
montgomerie-links-vietnam.notes: Par 72 (36/36), Colin Montgomerie design, 2009. Official hole-by-hole page; golfify (hole 1 = par 5) and kimigolf partial card (holes 4,5,6,9,11-15) consistent.

laguna-golf-lang-co.name: Laguna Golf Lang Co
laguna-golf-lang-co.region: Lang Co (Hue, 1 hr north of Da Nang)
laguna-golf-lang-co.notes: Par 71 (35/36), Nick Faldo design, 2013. Official design-facilities page hole list; golfingrecord card identical. Administratively in Hue city (Phu Loc), listed here because it is part of the Da Nang golf circuit.

hoiana-shores-golf-club.name: Hoiana Shores Golf Club
hoiana-shores-golf-club.region: Quang Nam (Duy Xuyen, south of Hoi An)
hoiana-shores-golf-club.notes: Par 71 (36/35), Robert Trent Jones Jr design, 2019/2020. Official site (hoiana.com/golf) has no scorecard text (course map is an image); official page shows only 16 = par 4, 17 = par 3, 18 = par 5, matching hole19. golfify (hole 1 = par 4) consistent. Total 71 matches official/golfasian.

vinpearl-golf-nam-hoi-an.name: Vinpearl Golf Nam Hoi An
vinpearl-golf-nam-hoi-an.region: Quang Nam (Thang Binh, south of Hoi An)
aliases: Vinpearl Resort & Golf Nam Hoi An
Vinpearl Golf Club Nam Hoi An
vinpearl-golf-nam-hoi-an.notes: Par 72 (36/36), IMG design, 2018. Official vinpearl.com page returns 403 (search snippet shows only 6 holes, e.g. hole 1 par 4 index 15 - consistent). hole19 card identical to GolfPass par row from search snippet. A golfingrecord card differs (5 = par 3, 16 = par 5, 18 = par 4) but it appears to be an older/other Vinpearl listing - not used.

long-thanh.name: Long Thanh Golf Club
aliases: Long Thanh Golf Club & Residential Estate
long-thanh.notes: 36 holes: Hill Course (Sân Đồi) + Lake Course (Sân Hồ), each par 72 (36/36). Read from the official scorecard images linked on https://longthanhgolfresort.com/choi-golf.html. Hill cross-checked with golfingrecord.com (matches all 18); Lake cross-checked with kimigolf.com (8 holes stated, all match).

dong-nai-golf-resort.name: Dong Nai Golf Resort
aliases: Bo Chang Dong Nai Golf Resort
dong-nai-golf-resort.notes: 27 holes (A/B/C), each nine par 36. Bo Chang Dong Nai Golf Resort is the same facility (Taiwanese owner Bo Chang; also called Song May). Official site dongnaigolf.com.vn has no readable scorecard (only a layout drawing), so pars come from golfify.io. A cross-checked with shotnavi.jp search snippet (matches). C: shotnavi.jp snippet lists hole 6 as par 4 (nine = 35) whereas golfify lists par 5 (594 yd) and 1golf.eu lists C as par 36 - golfify/1golf used. B hole 5/6 (5,4) from golfify page itself.

taekwang-jeongsan.name: Taekwang Jeongsan Country Club
taekwang-jeongsan.notes: 18 holes, par 72 (Sun 36 / Moon 36), Ong Con Island, Dai Phuoc, Nhon Trach. Official sites (jeongsancc.com.vn = empty directory listing; taekwangjeongsan.com unreachable) gave no scorecard, so pars from golfify.io; cross-checked with golfingrecord.com (all 18 match) and shotnavi.jp search snippet (matches). Do not confuse with the separate 'Jeongsan Country Club' Star/Moon/Sun 27-hole course listed on golfpass.

midas-valley-golf-club.name: Midas Valley Golf Club
midas-valley-golf-club.notes: golfingrecord 단일 출처 (파72, 5개 티 모두 파 동일). 코스 이름이 페이지에 없어 OUT/IN 으로 표기.

ananti-club-seoul.name: The Ananti Club Seoul
ananti-club-seoul.notes: golfingrecord. Jatnamu·Neutinamu 는 같은 클럽의 중복 페이지 2개에서 파 일치. Neutinamu 는 파35 (이 9홀 조합만 합계 36 아님). 27홀, 표기는 영문 코스명 그대로.

de-beach-golf-club.name: De Beach Golf Club
de-beach-golf-club.notes: hole19 단일 출처 (총 파72, 다른 목록들의 파72와 합계만 일치). 홀별 2차 대조 못 함 (golfpass·golfify 403).

tongyeong-dongwon-royal-country-club.name: Tongyeong Dongwon Royal Country Club
tongyeong-dongwon-royal-country-club.notes: hole19 단일 출처. 한려(Hallyo)=OUT, 미륵(Mireuk)=IN 표기. 전반 파는 검색 스니펫과 일치.

tan-son-nhat.name: Tan Son Nhat Golf Course
tan-son-nhat.notes: 36 holes, four nines A/B/C/D, each par 36. PAR read from the hole-by-hole tabs on the official homepage https://www.tansonnhatgolf.vn/ (tansonnhatgolf.com has a broken TLS certificate). Cross-checked: A and B match shotnavi.jp (https://shotnavi.jp/world/704/7/gc_3.htm); C and D match golfingrecord.com C/D card (https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/bbf74a97-7747-2080-3ca7-cdc5a5bf3717). No disagreements.

vietnam-golf-cc.name: Vietnam Golf & Country Club
vietnam-golf-cc.region: Ho Chi Minh City (Thu Duc / Long Thanh My)
vietnam-golf-cc.notes: Two 18-hole courses (East by Lee Trevino 1997, West by Chen King Shih 1994), both par 72 (36/36). Official site (https://www.vietnamgolfcc.com/en/golf-course.html, east-course.html, west-course.html) states par 72 only, no hole-by-hole scorecard, so third-party cards were used. East cross-checked with a second golfingrecord card (https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/02e30550-7d59-4390-9f3e-490cbfc9dbb7, same values) and golfpass search summary. West matches the golfpass summary (5-4-3-4-4-5-3-4-4 / 4-4-3-5-4-4-3-5-4); a partial kimigolf.com extraction showed West hole 13 as par 3 instead of 5, but that page was incomplete and two other sources agree on par 5.

flc-quy-nhon-golf-links.name: FLC Quy Nhon Golf Links
flc-quy-nhon-golf-links.notes: 36 holes: Ocean Course (Nicklaus Design, 2016) par 72 (36/36) and Mountain Course (Schmidt-Curley, 2017) par 72 (36/36). Official site (www.flcquynhon.com.vn) refused connection and www.flcresortquynhon.com does not resolve, so both cards are third-party (hole19golf.com, Black tee). Ocean cross-check: GolfPass/shotnavi search snippets confirm holes 1-3 = 4,4,5; top100golfcourses/planetgolf reviews confirm par 3 at 4, 8, 14, 16 and par 5 at 5, 11, 17, par 4 at 12, 13 - all consistent with hole19. Mountain cross-check: GolfPass scorecard par row (https://www.golfpass.com/courses/38123-flc-quy-nhon-golf-links-mountain-course/scorecard-and-layout, via search snippet; page itself returns 403) is identical to hole19 (5,4,3,4,4,4,3,5,4 / 4,5,3,4,3,4,5,4,4); planetgolf review confirms par 5 11th, par 3 14th, par 4 17th. One search snippet claimed shotnavi lists Mountain 17 as par 5 - not verified (shotnavi returned 403) and contradicted by GolfPass and golfbusinessnews (par-4 17th); kept par 4. Binh Dinh province was merged into Gia Lai province in 2025.

the-bluffs-ho-tram.name: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram
the-bluffs-ho-tram.notes: Par 71: OUT 35, IN 36. Read from official course page https://thebluffshotram.com/bluffs_course/ (hole-by-hole). Cross-checked with golfingrecord.com scorecard (https://www.golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/18a79b31-82a2-476c-af0e-585cbd461eed), identical for Gold/Blue/White tees. Red (ladies) tee is listed as par 73 on third-party card; not used. Greg Norman links course, Xuyen Moc district.

paradise-golf-vung-tau.name: Paradise Golf Vung Tau
paradise-golf-vung-tau.region: Ba Ria - Vung Tau (Vung Tau city)
paradise-golf-vung-tau.notes: 27 holes, each nine par 36 (A+B = par 72 is the usual 18). No reachable official website (paradisegolfvungtau.com does not resolve). Pars read from golfingrecord.com cards A/B/C. A and B cross-checked with hole19golf.com 'Combination A-B' card (https://www.hole19golf.com/courses/vung-tau-paradise-resort-golf-club) - identical. C could not be cross-checked (golfify.io and shotnavi.jp returned 403); golfify/shotnavi summaries confirm C totals 36. Some sites describe the nines as Lake/Ocean/Mountain, but all scorecards print A/B/C.

chau-duc-golf.name: Chau Duc Golf
chau-duc-golf.notes: Par 72 (36/36). Resort Course (18 holes, opened Nov 2023, Greg Norman design, Suoi Nghe commune). No official website found. Pars read from hole19golf.com. OUT cross-checked with shotnavi.jp summary (https://shotnavi.jp/world/704/12/gc_3.htm: 5,4,3,4,4,3,4,4,5) - identical; IN only confirmed as total 36 by shotnavi, hole-by-hole from hole19 only. A second 18 (Tournament Course) is planned but not open.
